identity.name: Injury: International Journal of the Care of the Injured
identity.source_note: Live guide is blocked to automated fetch (ScienceDirect CAPTCHA). source_hash is the SHA-256 of the normalized RAW Internet Archive snapshot of the official guide (web.archive.org/web/20250101id_/https://www.injuryjournal.com/content/authorinfo, captured ~2025-01) and is reproducible. Rules were encoded from this Internet Archive snapshot of the journal-home guide (matches the current headless-rendered ScienceDirect guide the rules were read from). Session C's freshness cron must use a headless fetch to re-verify the live page.

encoding_notes: Rules encoded from the live Elsevier ScienceDirect Guide-for-Authors for Injury (read via headless browser). source_hash is of the curl bot-challenge shell (rotating token, non-reproducible) — see identity.source_note.

Peer review is double-anonymized: separate title page (with author details, acknowledgements, competing-interest declaration, corresponding-author address) + anonymized manuscript with no identifying information. scrub_metadata set true as an inference required for effective double-anonymized review (not stated verbatim).

article_types: 'Full length articles' -> original_research; 'Review Articles' -> review; 'Letters to the Editor' -> letter. Case Reports are explicitly redirected to the companion open-access journal Trauma Case Reports and are NOT accepted in Injury -> omitted.

The guide states NO manuscript word limits, reference counts, or figure/table caps for full-length or review articles -> those word_limits are null; only the abstract cap (350 words) is given. sections encoded only for original_research (Introduction, Materials/Patients and Methods, Results, Discussion and Conclusions); review/letter body structure is not defined by the guide.

Abstract: 'concise and factual', max 350 words, not structured (no section labels prescribed). Keywords: 1 to 10 required, English. Highlights required: 3 to 5 bullet points, each max 85 characters (submitted as a separate file).

references: Elsevier numbered style mapped to 'custom' (not standard NLM/AMA/Vancouver): bracketed numbers in citation order, author initials before surname, year in parentheses, journal names abbreviated per LTWA (mapped to 'nlm'), DOIs encouraged. in_text_punctuation 'before' from the example 'as demonstrated [3,6].' (marker precedes the period). et_al_threshold not specified (examples list all authors).

tables: guide allows placement either next to the relevant text OR on separate page(s) at the end -> encoded 'in_text' (first-listed option); table caption position not stated -> null; numbered consecutively (arabic).

figures: separate files; formats span vector (EPS/PDF) and raster (TIFF/JPG/PNG); min_dpi 300 is the halftone minimum (line drawings 1000 dpi, combination 500 dpi). Figure callouts use 'Fig.' (per the 'Fig. A.1' appendix example). legends_location 'figure_legends_section' inferred from Elsevier convention (a captions list in the manuscript) — not stated verbatim.

declarations: Declaration of competing interests and funding disclosure are mandatory; CRediT author contributions are required for corresponding authors. Data statement is encouraged (not required). Clinical-trial registration (ICMJE) is required for trials, conditionally (noted, not in 'required').

layout: the guide only mandates an editable single-column Word/LaTeX file. Font (Times New Roman 12) and line_spacing (double) are placeholder defaults — NOT specified by the guide (Elsevier 'Your Paper Your Way' leaves initial-submission formatting flexible); page size, margins, alignment, line numbering, page numbers, and running head are unspecified and defaulted to none/false/null for the engine to flag.
misc: guide does not mention ORCID or a cover letter as required -> both false; title case not specified -> null.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
